card.line: Pharpar was a swift river of Damascus, named by Naaman, a man with leprosy, as a better place to wash than the waters of Israel.

moments.title: Naaman names the river
moments.text: Naaman was angry at Elisha's word to wash, and he said the Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, were better than all the waters of Israel. Then he left in a rage.
